reviews.review: I wasn't a fan of the game when this first came out due to the near future tech and performance issues (most likely the potato I was running at the time. Luckily the modding community stepped up, just as they did with the previous game.

One word HARDCORE, if you are the one that likes to do silly things like spam bullets running from point to point, enjoy side strafing while shooting oh and thinking jumping of a two story building is going to be safe, then this game is not for you. If you enjoy a slow paced shooter that rewards slow play and tactics then this is amazing and would argue that this is the best military shooter to this date!

Arma 3 is what I was looking for in a military themed PC game. There is so much content in this game that it has kept me interested in playing it for the last few years.
 Arma 3 is not just about shooting and blowing things up PvP or PvE, it is a sandbox that is only limited by your imagination. There are many ways to play this game. You can be on the front line in a battle or a part of the logistical support delivering personnel and vital supplies to where they are needed in the air on the land or sea. You can fly aircraft or drive ground vehicles and water craft on your own or as part of a crew. You can set the game up so that you are in command of multiple units of AI or real players like a strategy game, and play against other player commanders. I have had some great experiences playing Arma over the years.
 Use the editor to make your own scenarios and play them online with others or offline on your own. You can download mods to expand the game like vehicles, equipment, weapons and terrain from the Steam Workshop for free. There are also player made missions and campaigns in the Workshop to download and play for free.
The best war sim with the best graphics of all time!
